notes.title: Another New RPG Game Will Be Released
notes.notes:
A new RPG game developed by CapPlay will be released in March 2022. You can add it to your wishlist now!
Simple but innovative gameplay! A really good choice for people like dungeon crawls.

notes.title: The game will be on Autumn Sales with 60% OFF
notes.notes: The game will be on Autumn Sales next week with an amazing 60% OFF! You can add it to wishlist now!
